overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter of botanical ingredients based in India. We supply bulk Jatamansi powder produced from carefully selected roots. Our facility uses advanced milling technology to achieve a fine 80 to 100 mesh size. Every batch follows our 6-step manufacturing process to maintain consistent physical specifications and low moisture content.

We support global B2B buyers with reliable bulk supply, OEM capabilities, and private label services. The powder has an earthy aroma and bitter profile suited for commercial blending. We offer custom packaging, custom mesh adjustments, and comprehensive export documentation. Starting from a 5 kg minimum order quantity, our operations ensure consistent ingredient quality for diverse industrial manufacturing formulations.
highlights: Fine milled 80-100 mesh size for uniform blending
Moisture content maintained at or below 8 percent
Distinct earthy aroma and natural root profile
Standard shelf life of 24 months under dry storage
Manufactured through a rigorous 6-step production process
Low minimum order quantity starting at 5 Kg

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Jatamansi Powder?
faqs.a: Our standard minimum order quantity starts at 5 kg, accommodating both pilot batches and commercial bulk shipments.

faqs.q: What packaging options do you offer for bulk and retail brands?
faqs.a: We provide 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and small private-label retail pouches or jars.

faqs.q: Can buyers request samples before commercial procurement?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide product samples on request to allow technical teams to evaluate mesh size and material quality.

faqs.q: What are the primary specifications of this powder?
faqs.a: The product is fine milled to an 80 to 100 mesh size with a moisture limit of 8 percent or less.

faqs.q: How is the manufacturing process handled at TradeNest Naturals?
faqs.a: We operate a 6-step process comprising sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch.

faqs.q: Do you provide international shipping and export documentation?
faqs.a: Yes, as an IEC-registered exporter, TradeNest Naturals provides full export documentation support for cross-border logistics.
